fusions.name: Bolted Down
fusions.desc: A bite eaten on the move that deals 8 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Rolling Banquet
fusions.desc: Tips your laden cart over every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It deals 28 damage and restores 10 health to you. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Meals Brought Round
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fuel From the Table
fusions.desc: Each time you regain health, you also regain 6 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
